title: Private Washington DC Cart Tour with Expert Historian Guide
includes: Driver Guide : English, Russian and Amharic speeking
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Washington, DC on a customizable 3-hour private cart tour led by a professor of archaeology and anthropology. This expert-guided sightseeing experience goes beyond standard narration, offering deeper historical, cultural, and political insight into the nation’s most iconic landmarks.

Travel comfortably by private cart with strategic stops for walking and photos at the White House (North Lawn at Lafayette Square), United States Capitol, Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam Veterans Memorial, Martin Luther King, Jr. Memorial, Downtown Washington, and the National Mall.

Designed for travelers seeking more than a typical DC monuments tour, this experience combines convenience, expert storytelling, and academic perspective for a truly elevated introduction to Washington, DC.
